decisions.statement: A logical name is `fable` or `opus` or `sonnet` or `haiku`.
A logical name has one wire id.
A wire id has one logical name.
A wire id no longer served reads as the logical name that took its place.
A wire id no longer served is written by nothing here.
The extended-context marker is `[1m]`.
A raw name has the marker at the end of the raw name or nowhere.
The marker comes off a raw name before the rest of the raw name is read.
A raw name reads as a logical name or as a wire id.
A raw name naming no model reads as nothing.
A raw name that reads as nothing throws nothing.
Blanks around a raw name come off before the raw name is read.
A raw name that is the marker alone reads as nothing.
Which logical names can have extended context is named here.
A cli alias is a logical name.
A cli alias has the marker only for a model that can have the marker.
A cli alias has the marker only where the caller says extended context is to be had.
Nothing here sends a request.
Nothing here names a gateway.
Nothing here chooses which model work goes to.
Nothing here reads a model family page.

definition: the names a model is called by, and the reading between them
